run.requirements: Restore Flap and letscash.fun launches and prove stock-raffle binding and payout on Robinhood Chain.

summary.building: Synchronized production pins and live fork canaries for stock raffles across launchpads.
summary.topRisk: Upgradeable upstream launchpads can retain an address while changing versioned behavior or tuple selectors.
summary.mustDecideFirst: Retain the fail-closed commitment and approve only the exact v5.21.2 state after the lifecycle proof.
summary.watchOutFor: CI must expose the protected archive RPC under every environment alias used by registered tests.

risks.title: Mutable upstream version can stop every Flap launch
risks.detail: A legitimate Portal upgrade invalidates Sinjoh's reviewed commitment; compatibility must be lifecycle-tested and every pin updated together without removing the guard.

risks.title: Public version documentation can lag live state
risks.detail: Production approval must use live onchain state plus an end-to-end fork rather than static version text alone.

risks.title: Proxy upgrade silently changes all launch selectors
risks.detail: The stable proxy and its runtime hash remain unchanged while a TokenParams field changes every tuple-taking selector; the active implementation and ABI must be pinned and lifecycle-tested.

risks.title: A normal salt-search miss can abort a launch
risks.detail: Bounded vanity searches can exhaust; the launch path must retry contract-level misses while propagating RPC and transport failures.

risks.title: A missing RPC environment alias can prevent registered canaries from running
risks.detail: The runner must expose the validated protected RPC under every alias consumed by the registered fork tests.

preCodingDecisions.title: Approve exact Portal commitment
preCodingDecisions.detail: Use 0xd11206f76d4086d0aab6f96707b25806347b07d7ef45197bf15699765ef975d3 only after the full v5.21.2 lifecycle proof passes.

requirementsCorrections.detail: Every mutable upstream commitment used by production launch must have a current-state fork canary.
Stock-raffle readiness includes exact route readback, launch, mandatory binding, revenue conversion, draw, and payout.
A stable proxy address and proxy runtime do not prove that launch tuple selectors remain callable after an implementation upgrade.
